question: Does the residual Fano asymmetry of the 25a-cell spectra (|q| = 0.034 to 0.501) come from the reflections at the finite guide ends?

protocol.rule: every run parameter equal to the archive record of the same index; only --sonlandirma emici --emici_kalinlik 8 and the label differ; enforced key by key before the run (31_uret_gorevler_S4b.py) and again on the output (G1)

criterion.statistic: factor = |q|_archive / |q|_absorber at each index, both fitted with the manuscript's Fano routine
criterion.refutes: factor <= 1.5 (the asymmetry has another source at that index)
criterion.pass: supports at all seven indices, every gate passed, S1 satisfied
criterion.origin: README_S4.md: 'a factor well above unity at every index confirms ...; a factor near unity at any index means the asymmetry has another source there'; the numbers are the author's reading, fixed here

gates.G1: parameters equal the archive record key by key apart from the label and the termination keys
gates.G2: identical frequency grids, relative tolerance 1e-12 (archive and H14b, cavity and reference runs)
gates.G3: fitted resonance at least 5 linewidths inside both window edges
gates.G4: fit rms <= 0.05, lambda_r inside the window, 0 < FWHM < window/5
gates.G5: t_end / tau >= 3 with tau = Q/(pi f_r); the archive spectra have 3.48 to 5.54
gates.S1: absorber Q interpolated to n_a = 1.33 within 5 % of 4495.1 (harmonic inversion, same absorber cell, H4b)
gates.rule: a row that fails a gate is reported as failed and not graded

expectations_not_criteria.factor: about 9: first order in the end reflection, like the suppression of the ln Q oscillation by the absorber (8.6 after detrending, supplementary P7). Flagged: an estimate, not a criterion
expectations_not_criteria.absorber_Q: about 5090, 4580, 4140, 3780 at n_a = 1.300 to 1.375 (reconstructed from the truncated H14 spectra; post hoc)
expectations_not_criteria.absorber_q_floor: about 1e-4 on the archive grid for a symmetric resonance (fit of a noiseless Lorentzian)
expectations_not_criteria.T_max_near_resonance: close to 1 with the absorber; the archive reaches 1.25 from the Fabry-Perot standing wave
expectations_not_criteria.cost: references about 20 min; spectra 2 to 3 h, at most about 4 h (t_max 32000 at about 7e7 pixel-steps per second with 14 concurrent tasks); one exclusive node
